headline: Cheaper clicks, thinner leads: $5,449 NP on a flat Friday
commentary:
### The day
- NP $5,449 at 10.9% margin, well short of last Friday.
  - NP: $5,449 v $7,851 last Fri
  - Leads: 3,166 v 3,147
- Spend and volume sat on the eight-Friday average; EPL just under it.
  - Cost: $44,412 v $44,799 mean
  - EPL: $15.75 v $16.33 mean
  - NP: $5,449 v $8,295 mean
- October still a long way ahead of September on the same days.
  - MTD NP: $159,673 v $141,489
  - MTD margin: 14.1% v 10.0%
### What drove it
- Search clicks came cheaper and converted fine; the leads simply paid less.
  - Search CPC: $11.48 v $12.66
  - **Search EPL: $22.44 v $28.38** last Fri
  - Search EPL MTD: $27.94
- payday_alternative spent $4,400 less; bad_credit and generic picked up cheaper clicks.
  - payday_alternative: $8,611 v $13,016
  - bad_credit CPC: $11.66 v $14.21
- **uprova** stepped up hard across the account while our share barely moved.
  - uprova account IS: 43.0% v 30.5%
  - payday_alternative: 65.6% v 42.7%
- Bing paid up for clicks and got the same lead value.
  - Bing CPC: $5.13 v $3.96
  - Bing EPL: $13.56 v $13.40
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 30/10 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SA to ROAS: competitor | tROAS only, uncapped | $847 | $959 | — |
| speed walk-down | high tROAS, stepping down | $1,251 | $980 | — |
| Scavengers | tROAS v tCPA pair | $1,275 | $1,398 | — |
- Scavengers are off at weekends, so Saturday and Sunday will read zero.
  - Scavenger clicks: 360 at $3.54 average
- speed is still deliberately priced out of the auction at a high target.
  - speed IS: 11.3% v 10.0%
watch: Search EPL at $22.44 against $27.94 month-to-date — one Friday, but a second and third soft day would make it a level rather than a wobble.
uprova's share climb, account-wide and 23 points in payday_alternative, and whether our CPCs start following it back up.
Bing CPC at $5.13 against $4.49 for the month with EPL flat, which is where its 18.8% margin goes if it sticks.
